title: Hostility Detection in UK Politics: A Dataset on Online Abuse Targeting MPs
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hostility in tweets directed at UK Members of Parliament (MPs), where one of the targeted identity characteristics is religion.
findings: Non-Christian Members of Parliament (MPs) face significantly higher levels of religion-based and general hostility compared to their Christian counterparts. Models were evaluated on their ability to detect religion-based hostility as a sub-task, with GPT-3.5 (prompted with definitions) achieving the highest F1-score in a hierarchical classification setting that included religion as a category of hostility.
